config.label: DataCanvas provider for the bioactivity spill and the chembl_dataframe_* SQL tools; DuckDB is the default
config.description: DataCanvas provider for the bioactivity spill and the chembl_dataframe_* SQL tools; DuckDB is the default. Set to 'none' to disable it: large bioactivity sets then inline a preview but never spill.

config.label: Base URL for the ChEMBL REST data API
config.description: Base URL for the ChEMBL REST data API. Override for a private mirror or pinned host.

config.label: Per-attempt timeout in milliseconds for an upstream ChEMBL request, capped by what is left of the call's time budget (45 s for most calls, CHEMBL_SPILL_DEADLINE_MS for a bioactivity spill)
config.description: Per-attempt timeout in milliseconds for an upstream ChEMBL request, capped by what is left of the call's time budget (45 s for most calls, CHEMBL_SPILL_DEADLINE_MS for a bioactivity spill).

config.label: Rows per upstream ChEMBL page (max 1000)
config.description: Rows per upstream ChEMBL page (max 1000). The bioactivity spill walks pages of this size; an inline bioactivity page requests its limit, capped at this size.

config.label: Default result limit applied when callers omit it
config.description: Default result limit applied when callers omit it.

config.label: Ceiling on rows chembl_get_bioactivities stages to a DataCanvas table, and so on the upstream page walk behind it
config.description: Ceiling on rows chembl_get_bioactivities stages to a DataCanvas table, and so on the upstream page walk behind it. Over the cap the response reports truncated: true and truncated_by: "row_cap".

config.label: Most chembl_get_bioactivities spill-page requests in flight at once (1–6), shared by every call on the server
config.description: Most chembl_get_bioactivities spill-page requests in flight at once (1–6), shared by every call on the server.

config.label: Time budget in milliseconds for one chembl_get_bioactivities spill, its count and page walk (10000–600000)
config.description: Time budget in milliseconds for one chembl_get_bioactivities spill, its count and page walk (10000–600000). At expiry the rows fetched so far stage with truncated: true and truncated_by: "time_budget".

config.label: Set to 'true' to register the opt-in chembl_dataframe_drop tool (absent from tools/list when off)
config.description: Set to 'true' to register the opt-in chembl_dataframe_drop tool (absent from tools/list when off).

config.label: Sets the minimum log level for output (e
config.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
